name: European PV–AEM methane reference
scope: Candidate design for European regional anchors. No installation, procurement quote or site calibration is asserted.

assets.name: 1,667 × Trina TSM-NEG19RC.20, 600 W bin
assets.envelope: STC module rating; NOCT 43 ± 2°C; power temperature coefficient −0.29%/°C. Module temperature rating −40 to 85°C is not an ambient range.
assets.gaps: No string/inverter design, rear-side gain, structural assessment or site shading survey. NOCT approximation does not model wind explicitly.

assets.name: 4 × Enapter AEM Flex 120, rev08 base configuration
assets.basis: Published nominal figures + aggregate hourly approximation
assets.envelope: Per skid: 112 kW, 2.16 kg H₂/h; published specific consumption 51.3 kWh/kg; 12–100% nominal flow. Full-load beginning-of-life figures at 55°C electrolyte and 15°C ambient. 400 V AC supply, liquid cooling and purified water required.
assets.gaps: Use 112/2.16 kWh/kg to reconcile rounded nominal power and flow; not a fitted load curve. Minimum flow approximated as aggregate minimum power. Start energy, cold start, ambient range and multi-skid staging remain uncalibrated. DC/AC conversion, dryer and external cooling power are unresolved.

assets.gaps: Vendor, temperature derating, ageing and installation requirements unidentified.

assets.gaps: Pressure, compression, piping, certified vessel and delivered gas quality unresolved.

assets.name: Generic supplied-CO₂ buffer

assets.name: Generic methanator
assets.envelope: Configured heat balance and temperature band.

assets.name: Human service escalation; no autonomous interventions enabled
assets.envelope: Qualified personnel, safe access, isolation, spares, water treatment, ventilation, cooling, communications and acceptance tests must be arranged.
assets.gaps: No support contract or response-time evidence. Existing simulated human replacement/calibration is not approved OEM service. Cleaner, rover and reset capabilities need task-specific evidence before deployment claims.
